resources.string: Couldn't reach your watch. Your recording continues there; stop it on your watch or try again.
Playback is still on your phone. Check your watch connection and try again.
This recording is not available in your watch library yet. Check what syncs in Watch settings, then try again. Playback is still on your phone.
Your watch is still starting LogDate. Open LogDate on your watch, then try again. Playback is still on your phone.
Your watch did not answer the handoff. Check its connection and try again. Playback is still on your phone.
LogDate could not open the recording on your watch. Open the watch app, then try again. Playback is still on your phone.
Your watch could not verify this phone. Finish watch setup or reconnect it in Watch settings. Playback is still on your phone.
Your watch could not start playback. Check its speaker or headphones, then try again. Playback is still on your phone.
The recording on your phone changed or finished before the handoff completed. Start it again to continue on your watch.
